about.title: From Our Island To Your Table
about.description: DRIO began with a suitcase of curry powder and a long way from home.

intro.heading: A pantry that tastes like home
intro.body: Every jar starts on a smallholding in Sri Lanka — jackfruit and breadfruit sliced by hand, chillies dried in the sun, spices roasted in small batches the way they have been for generations. Nothing is rushed, because the flavour is in the waiting.
intro.second: We pack for export quality and ship across Japan, so a Colombo kitchen is a few days away wherever you cook.

sourcing.title: Grown, not manufactured
sourcing.body: We buy from the families who farm it, at a price that keeps them farming.

process.title: Dried, never diluted
process.body: Sun and air do the work. No fillers, no colouring, no anti-caking agents.

delivery.title: Packed for the journey
delivery.body: Sealed to survive the trip and to keep its aroma the day you open it.

cta.title: Start with the shelf
cta.body: Browse the pantry, or read what to cook with it first.

contact.title: Contact Us
